coverageNotes: BA-01: All 221 federal, statewide and legislative candidate contests match the official general-election export. Official sample ballots add all 114 district-court contests with 117 candidates, countywide offices in 15 counties, Hennepin Commissioner District 3, and Minneapolis school at-large. Whole-county judicial memberships follow Minnesota Statutes 2.722. Minneapolis at-large school coverage follows the city election office. Other county, city, school and special-district contests and local measures remain open; commissioner District 3 reader boundary resolution is not yet implemented.
